book.name: SAN JUAN
book.title: Ri lok'olaj ch'abel ri niya'o colotajic ri tz'ibatal ca ruma San Juan

content: Tek ri Jesús xubij chi Riya' achi'el ri juwi' uva
Y yac'ari' tek ri Jesús xubij: Yin c'a riyin ri kitzij chi yin achi'el juwi' uva, y ri Nata' yari' ri achi'el aj samajel chrij ri uva.

Ruma tek juwi' uva yec'o ruk'a' ri xa ma yewachin ta, ye'elesex el. Yac'a ri ruk'a' ri can yewachin, yejosk'ix jabel, riche (rixin) chi yewachin jabel. Can que c'a chuka' ri' riyin. Ri Nata' yerutz'et quinojel ri yec'o wuq'ui y yerelesaj el ri ma niwachin ta ri quic'aslen. Yac'a ri niwachin ri quic'aslen, xqueruch'ajch'ojsaj, riche (rixin) chi sibilaj xtiwachin ri quic'aslen.
Riyix ri can nk'alajsan wi pe ri ch'abel chiwech, can yix ch'ajch'oj chic c'a ruma ri ch'abel ri'.

Can quixc'oje' c'a wuq'ui jurayil, riche (rixin) chi queri' riyin can yic'oje' c'a chuka' iwuq'ui riyix. Ruma ri ruk'a' ri uva ma niwachin ta, wi xa man c'o ta riq'ui ri ruchi'el. Can nic'atzin chi jun ruk'a' uva c'o riq'ui ri ruchi'el, riche (rixin) chi queri' niwachin. Can queri' chuka' riyix, rajawaxic chi can quixc'oje' wuq'ui.

Yin c'a riyin ri achi'el juwi' uva, y riyix ri ruk'a'. Ri can jurayil nic'oje' wuq'ui, y riyin riq'ui riya', ri ruc'aslen can xtiwachin wi. Ruma ri xa ma xtic'oje' ta wuq'ui, majun c'a ri xticowin ta xtuben.

Ri xa ma nic'oje' ta c'a wuq'ui jurayil, xtuc'ulwachij c'a achi'el nuc'ulwachij ri ruk'a' uva ri xa ma niwachin ta. Ye'elesex el ruma ma yewachin ta, y tek ye chaki'j chic, yebemol pe, y yec'ak pa k'ak', y chiri' yec'at wi.
Yac'a riyix can quixc'oje' wuq'ui jurayil, y tic'oje' ri nuch'abel pan iwánima. Wi queri' xtiben, tic'utuj c'a chare ri Dios achique ri nrajo' ri iwánima, y can xtuya' wi c'a pe chiwe ri nic'utuj.
Wi can niwachin jabel ri ic'aslen, can nik'alajin wi chi yix tzekelbey wuche (wixin), y ri winek ri xquixtz'eto, can xtiquiya' c'a ruk'ij ruc'ojlen ri Nata'.
Can achi'el c'a yirajo' ri Nata', can queri' chuka' yixinwajo' riyin. Can quixc'oje' c'a jurayil chupan re ajowanic re'.

Y wi riyix can niben ri nubij ri nupixa', can xquixc'oje' c'a jurayil chupan ri ajowabel wuche (wixin) riyin. Achi'el ri nbanon riyin; can nben ri yerubij ri Nata', y rumari' can jurayil yinc'o chupan ri ajowabel riche (rixin) Riya'.
Y ronojel c'a ri nbin chic chiwe, can riche (rixin) c'a chi tiquicot ri iwánima, can achi'el ri quicoten ri c'o wuq'ui riyin. Y can tz'aket ta c'a chuka' ri quicoten xtic'oje' pa tak iwánima.
Y riyin nya' c'a ca re pixa' re' chiwe, chi can tiwajo' c'a iwi';
can achi'el ri yixinwajo' riyin.
Majun chic jun ri can más ta nim ri ajowabel c'o riq'ui, que chuwech jun ri can nuya' ruc'aslen
pa quiq'uexel ri ramigos.
Y riyix can yix nu'amigos, wi niben ronojel ri nbij chiwe ri c'o chi niben.

Ruma riyin can amigos chic nbanon chiwe, ruma can ronojel ri ruk'alajsan pe ri Nata' chuwe riyin, can xink'alajsaj c'a chuka' chiwe riyix. Y ma yix achi'el ta chic mozos nbanon chiwe. Ruma jun mozo ma retaman ta achique nuch'ob ri rupatrón.
Ri xcha'o iwuche (iwixin) riyix, yin c'a riyin, y xa ma yix ta c'a riyix ri xixcha'o wuche (wixin) riyin.
Y riyin xixincha' riche (rixin) chi yixintek chubanic ri nusamaj
y riche (rixin) chuka' chi ri ic'aslen niwachin, y jurayil ta c'a xtiwachin ri ic'aslen, riche (rixin) chi queri' xabachique c'a ri xtic'utuj chare ri Nata' pa nubi' riyin, can xtuya' pe chiwe.
Can nchilabej c'a chiwe chi tiwajo' c'a iwi' chi'iwonojel.
Ri Jesús y ri ye tzekelbey riche (rixin) ye'etzelex cuma ri winek
Y wi yixetzelex
cuma ri winek ri xa riq'ui re ruwach'ulef quicukuban wi quic'u'x, tinatej chiwe chi ma xu (xe) ta wi chiwe riyix queri' niquiben, xa can queri' chuka' quibanon pe chuwe riyin.
Wi riyix xa ta yix junan quiq'ui ri winek ri xa riq'ui re ruwach'ulef quicukuban wi quic'u'x, can ta yixcajo' jabel.
Pero riyin can xixincha' yan pe chiquicojol y ma yix junan ta chic quiq'ui, y rumari' yixquetzelaj.
Can tinatej c'a chiwe ri xinbij chiwe, chi ri mozo ma ya ta ri' ri más ta nim ruk'ij que chuwech ri patrón. Y wi riyin ri Iwajaf yinetzelex cuma ri winek
y c'o pokon niquiben chuwe, riyix chuka' xa can queri' xtiban chiwe. Pero ri winek ri niquiben ri nubij ri nuch'abel riyin, xa can niquiben chuka' ri nibij riyix chique.
Ronojel c'a ri pokonal ri' xtic'ulwachij pa quik'a', ruma ma quetaman ta ruwech ri Dios
ri yin takayon pe, y rumari' yixquetzelaj, ruma icukuban ic'u'x wuq'ui riyin.
Y wi man ta xipe riyin chuwech re ruwach'ulef chuk'alajsaxic ri nuch'abel, riye' can ta yecowin niquibij chi majun quimac.
Yac'a re wacami, ruma riyin xipe chuwech re ruwach'ulef y xinquetzelaj, rumari' riye' can ma xquecowin ta xtiquibij chi majun quimac.
Ri can ye'etzelan wuche (wixin) riyin, can ma xu (xe) ta c'a riyin ri yinquetzelaj, xa can nik'alajin c'a chi queri' chuka' niquiben chare ri Nata'.
Y man ta jun quimac, wi ta riyin man ta nbanon
nima'k tak milagros chiquiwech, milagros ri majun chic jun banayon ta. Yac'a re wacami riye' can xquitz'et yan ri milagros ri' y ma riq'ui wi ri' xa yinquetzelaj riyin y niquetzelaj chuka' ri Nata'.
Ronojel c'a re', can ntajin chic rubanic, can achi'el nubij ri tz'ibatal ca chupan ri ruch'abel ri Dios: Yinquetzelaj y xa ma k'alaj ta achique ruma,
ruma majun numac. Quec'ari' ri tz'ibatajnek ca.
Yac'a tek riyin yin tzolijnek chic chila' chicaj riq'ui ri Nata', xtintek c'a pe ri Lok'olaj Espíritu
ri xtito'o iwuche (iwixin), y xquixrutijoj c'a riq'ui ri kitzij. Y ri Lok'olaj Espíritu ri' riq'ui c'a ri Nata' nipe wi, y tek xtipe, can xquiruk'alajsaj chuka' riyin.
Y riyix can xquinik'alajsaj
c'a chuka' chiquiwech ri winek; ruma chi can pa rutiquiribel pe ri yixc'o pe wuq'ui.
